summary: Add a read-only, local-only catalog of what each repository under --root declares itself to be

delivery.outcome: Add a `monag catalog` subcommand: for one repository (--root is a checkout), or every repository under --root, reports what each project declares itself to be (description, stack, entry points, docs/tests/changelog presence, last commit) read verbatim from its own manifests and README -- no network calls, no LLM-generated text.
nonGoals: No network calls (no gh/GitHub API metadata) and no LLM summarization; an undeclared description is reported as unknown, never guessed.
No browser, password-manager, or session credential access of any kind.
No write access to any scanned repository.

architecture.decision: Add src/monag/catalog.py reusing audit.py's repository-discovery (targets()) plus local manifest/README parsing (pyproject.toml, package.json, README.md); wire a new `monag catalog` subcommand and JSON/Markdown reporting following the resume/audit conventions.
architecture.rollback: Revert the application slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Catalog module and CLI wiring regression suite passes.
